improvementsFromV02: Hero tile faces flattened; internal masonry removed.
Roads distinctly darkened relative to placement faces.
Heavy end-cap frames and stone cracks removed from road tiles.
Low-contrast longitudinal guide rails replace heavy curbs.
Four full-square corners retained; tiny inside joints added.
No locked cell or character redraw.
knownIssues: Source tile widths/heights still differ; runtime viewports normalize to squares.
Guide rail endpoint offsets and tiny inner corner joints remain imperfect; not mathematically seamless.
Interior alpha mainly 253-254; low-alpha edge flecks remain.
Character contrast test uses original sheet pixels behind approximate SVG clip paths, not production sprites.
No engine changes, import, final alpha/compression QA or performance test.
